title: Plan Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Plan module.

plan_options_count.description: Number of Propose options evaluated during planning

chosen_approach_summary.description: One sentence describing the chosen approach

expert_perspectives_applied.description: Domain labels of expert perspectives applied. Min 2 required.

adversary_triggered.description: Whether Adversary budget gate fired for this plan

grader_score.description: Score from Grader receipt. null if adversary_triggered = false.

grader_verdict.description: Verdict from Grader receipt. null if adversary_triggered = false.

open_risks.description: Risk strings for unresolved concerns after expert review

go_no_go.description: Plan verdict before handing to Decompose

plan_artifact_path.description: Path to the plan artifact document

human_escalation_required.description: true when NO_GO or CONDITIONAL with human resolution needed
